description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between Cost and Reliability Score for different model configurations. The x-axis, labeled "Cost," features a linear scale with a visible range from just below 2 to beyond 8, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 2 (2, 4, 6, 8). The y-axis, labeled "Reliability Score," uses a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 20 (30, 50, 70, 90). The plot contains three solid lines with solid circular markers. The blue line, labeled "3-Model Ensemble" in the legend, shows a steady upward trend; it begins at an approximate x-value of 1 with a Reliability Score of roughly 82, rises to approximately 88 at an x-value of 4.5, and ends at an x-value near 8.5 with a score of approximately 92. The red line, labeled "2-Model Ensemble," also exhibits a steady upward trend, starting at an x-value of approximately 1 with a Reliability Score of about 85, intersecting the blue line near an x-value of 4.5 and a score of 88, and concluding at an x-value of roughly 8.5 with a score of 90. Finally, an unlabeled yellow line demonstrates a steady downward trend across the plot, beginning at an x-value of approximately 1 with a Reliability Score of roughly 88, declining to a marked point near an x-value of 4.5 with a score of approximately 72, and continuing downward to end near an x-value of 8.5 and a score of approximately 55.
